lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: MOVE THAT HEAVY BOX NOW [beat] OR UNCLE JAMAL WILL LOCK US IN THIS DUSTY CRAWLSPACE UNTIL MONDAY MORNING!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: My hands are literally covered in black grease [beat] and I think I just saw a spider the size of a dinner plate crawling near my leg!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: This is totally unfair [beat] we barely even touched those scooters and now we are basically unpaid labor for his weird car collection!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: Wait [beat] look behind this stack of old tires [beat] why does Jamal have a golden key taped under the handle of the broken scooter?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That is not a broken brake cable at all [beat] it is actually a release wire for a secret compartment hidden right inside the frame!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I see you finally found the hidden latch [beat] though I honestly expected it to take you three days of scrubbing to notice it.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You lied about the brakes being broken [beat] just so you could watch us suffer while cleaning your disgusting garage, didn't you?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Actually [beat] I needed to know if you were observant enough to handle the real prize waiting inside that secret slot.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: No way [beat] is that a VIP pass to the National E-Scooter Championship for the whole squad [beat] and four brand new racing models?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: The 'broken' scooters were just a test of character [beat] you had to prove you would stick together even when the work got dirty!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I knew you weren't actually a total villain Uncle Jamal [beat] even if your garage smells like old socks and engine oil!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Forget the cleaning [beat] grab the new racing boards because we have a championship to win before the sun goes down tonight!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how a weekend of punishment [beat] turned into the ultimate upgrade for the fastest crew in the entire neighborhood.
